notes.title: 🚀 750+ Demo Downloads!
notes.content:
🚀 Thank You for 750+ Downloads — Can You Survive the Asteroids?
Hey space pilots! 👾🪐

A huge THANK YOU to everyone who has downloaded the Astro Busters Demo!
We’ve just passed 750+ brave players blasting their way through asteroid fields — and we couldn’t be more excited! 💥🚀

But the real question is:
Have you found the hidden secrets?
Have you beaten the boss?
And can you master all ships and weapons in the demo?

🧡 What’s next?
We’re actively working on the early access version, which will include:

* 3 missions
* More weapons
* More bosses
* Fixes

We are also working on the super exciting multiplayer which is planned for the full version late 2025.

💡 If you enjoyed the demo:
👉 Add Astro Busters to your Wishlist to be the first to know when the full version launches — and unlock early access discounts!
👉 Leave feedback in the Community Hub — your thoughts help shape the game!

Thanks for being part of the Astro Busters crew.
See you out there in the asteroid fields! 🌌💣

🪐 Wishlist Astro Busters on Steam now!
